text:
sam: heads-up  we need a single, reproducible migration playbook for pinned models + deprecations. focus: tenant risk scoring, simulator run, comms flow, and billing credits. goal: minimize surprise and reduce manual work for CSMs.
taylor: propose a two-phase risk score: technical risk (perf/quality) and business risk (usage surface + SLA). combine into 0-100 score. thresholds: <=20 auto-self-serve, 21-60 CSM assisted, >60 block.
uma: simulator detail: do a replay of a 1% sampled traffic window (configurable) and compute: p95 latency change, token-cost delta, response embed cosine mean, and a hallucination flag rate using golden prompts. return paired diffs for inspection.
victor: runtime constraints: simulator must be read-only and not affect KV caches or rate-limit buckets. mirror requests to simulator cluster with header X-Sim-Run and a correlation id. store results for 45 days max.
wendy: comms cadence: advisory (45d) -> follow-up (21d) -> decision notice (7d). include an in-console "Preview impact" CTA that links to simulator report and suggested migration date.
sam: billing/legal: credits are ok but need guardrails. recommend automated credit only when technical risk <=10 AND tenant monthly spend < $25k. otherwise manual credits. record credit_grant_id in tenant metadata.
taylor: technical rollout: 1) simulator API (/simulate_migration) 2) per-tenant migration plan generator 3) UI preview + one-click migrate 4) autopilot mode (if tenant opted-in). each step gated by privacy review.
uma: golden prompt curation: maintain two sets: function-call heavy prompts and free-text prompts. tests: embedding-sim threshold >=0.92 for green; quality delta (human eval proxy) <1% absolute drop. lower bounds trigger amber.
victor: ops: add model-catalog flags: allow_auto_migrate (bool), migration_policy (enum: immediate, delayed, manual), migration_grace_days (int). ensure these are surfaced in tenant APIs.
wendy: CSM workflow: simulator report should auto-create a draft migration ticket with recommended options: auto-migrate+credit, scheduled migration (CSM assist), or request engineering exception. ticket must include sample diffs and risk breakdown.
sam: monitoring: post-migration we need a 14-day watch: key metrics p95 latency, embeddings mean sim, error_rate, and cost_per_token. create alerts for any metric outside expected band.
taylor: canary strategy: start with 3% traffic for 48h, evaluate quick checks, then 10% for 72h. rollback if quality delta >2.5% or cost >25%.
uma: privacy: PII scrub on snapshots (hash inputs + redact named entities) and opt-out per-tenant. logs should never store raw user content.
victor: infra deliverables: sandbox replay cluster, simulator DB (TTL 45d), schema bump for tenant metadata, and a throttled job runner for large-tenants so we don't overload infra.
wendy: owners: sam (policy & billing), taylor (canary + platform), numa (benchmarks & eval), victor (infra), wendy (CS playbooks & comms). aim for alpha in 4 sprints.
deploy-bot: notice: branch migration-playbook queued; schema changes: tenant_meta.v4 -> adds allow_auto_migrate, migration_policy, migration_grace_days.
sam: let's reconvene Tue 11am with first cut of risk formula + one sample simulator report. :white_check_mark:
